program.help:
Strip spike waveforms from the raw .dat file to produce a spike-cleaned recording: <session>-spkclean.dat
The original .dat is never modified.
SUBTRACTION MODEL
When .clu.N files are present for an electrode group, per-cluster template modelling is used:
Asymmetric-exponential PC1 waveform model The dominant axis of waveform shape variation (amplitude, tau_fall, and AHP co-vary along PC1 due to Na+ inactivation) is captured as a continuous template family: T(t; obs_wf) = T_mean(t) + pc1_score(obs_wf) * T_pc1(t) Both T_mean and T_pc1 are fit as sums of asymmetric exponential terms per channel. pc1_score is measured directly from the observed waveform.
Contamination exclusion Spikes whose waveform windows overlap any other spike (within ±nSamples) are excluded from template estimation. A trimmed-mean fallback is used when too few uncontaminated spikes remain.
ISI-driven burst shape compensation A dual-template model (full-recovery vs. burst) with an exponential recovery fit handles Na+ inactivation shape changes during bursting.
Projection-based amplitude scaling The optimal scalar k = dot(obs_wf, T) / dot(T, T) is applied so that only the genuine spike signal is removed without amplifying noise.
When no .clu.N exists for a group, the raw .spk.N waveforms are subtracted directly.
PARAMETERS
# redetectSpikes
Whether to run a second round of spike detection on the cleaned dat immediately after writing it.
no Write session-spkclean.dat and stop (default). yes Call ndm_redetectspikes, which high-pass filters the cleaned dat, detects missed spikes, merges them into .res.N/.spk.N/.clu.N (new spikes get cluster ID 0), deletes stale .fet.N files, and removes the cleaned dat and its filtered version. After this, re-run ndm_pca and ndm_klustakwik to sort the merged spike set.
TYPICAL WORKFLOW
ndm_extractspikes detect spikes from .fil ndm_pca compute features ndm_klustakwik auto-sort clusters (klusters — manual curation) ndm_stripdat produce session-spkclean.dat ndm_lfp create LFP from cleaned dat (auto-detected) ndm_redetectspikes second-round detection (optional)
